The '''2007–08 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 72nd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece and the second under the name ''Super League''. The season began on 1 September 2007 and ended on 20 April 2008. The defending champions were [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]]. [[Asteras Tripolis F.C.|Asteras Tripolis]], [[Veria F.C.|Veria]] and [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] were promoted from [[Football League (Greece)|Beta Ethniki]] in the [[2006–07 Beta Ethniki|previous season]].

==Postponement==
On 25 August, the Super League and the [[Hellenic Football Federation]] decided to postpone the opening fixtures scheduled for that weekend (25 and 26 August) due to [[2007 Greek forest fires|the ongoing fire disaster]] in the south of Greece (especially in the [[Peloponnese]] and [[Euboea]]). The championship started on 1 September 2007. Matchday 2 was carried out on the weekend of 21–22 September due to [[UEFA Euro 2008 qualifying|UEFA Euro 2008 qualifying matches]] (8 September) and [[Greek legislative election, 2007|Greek legislative election]] (16 September).

On 20 February 2008 [[UEFA]] president [[Michel Platini]] presented the Hellenic Football Federation with a [[Swiss franc|CHF]] 1&nbsp;million cheque to help finance the rebuilding of football facilities damaged by the fires in Greece that summer.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/uefa/keytopics/kind=64/newsid=661039.html |title=UEFA helps Greece rebuild |publisher=UEFA |access-date=2013-04-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080223212731/http://www.uefa.com/uefa/keytopics/kind%3D64/newsid%3D661039.html |archive-date=2008-02-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Play-offs==
The play-off winner enters the [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League qualifying rounds#Second qualifying round|UEFA Champions League's second qualifying round]], a two-legged tier from which the winner advances to the [[UEFA Champions League 2008-09#Third qualifying round|3rd round qualification of the UEFA Champions League]]. The winner of the [[2007–08 Greek Football Cup|Greek Football Cup]] automatically qualifies for the [[2008–09 UEFA Cup]], as well as the runners-up of the Super League play-off.

In the play-off for Champions League, the teams play each other in a home and away [[round-robin tournament|round robin]]. However, they do not all start with zero points. Instead, a weighting system applies to the teams' standing at the start of the play-off mini-league. The team finishing fifth in the Super League will start the play-off with zero points. The fifth place team's end of season tally of points is subtracted from the sum of the points that other teams have. This number is then divided by three to give the other teams the points with which they start the mini-league.

The teams started the play-offs with the following number of points:
*AEK Athens – 8
*Panathinaikos – 7
*Aris – 2
*Panionios – 0
